notes.title: DEFINITE EDITION l Patch 1.3.0
notes.content: Version 1.3.0 of the game represents 3 years of constant improvement and that is why we have decided to release the definitive edition, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5.

notes.title: Sarah Garcia #WelcomeToTHEORIGIN
notes.content:
[Characters]
Sarah Garcia (Moe Rock)

- Today we went to that scary mansion
- The Garcia mansion?
-Yes, and we saw that old woman, Sarah Garcia, she asked us to take her furniture, but her face is terrifying and she had chills.

Sarah Garcia is the matriarch of the Garcia family. She is the woman who knows all the dark secrets of the Town and who pulls the strings at her convenience. Be careful when you see her ... just ... don't see her.

#WelcomeToTHEORIGIN

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
-FOV system fixed.
-Exposure reset after dead fixed.
-Next mission after talk with gravedigger (it was so complicated find the gravedigger note to continue the game)
-Mixes logo overlap after use and reused fixed.
-Add final comment "New Game + Available" to mention those who have finished the game, they already access New Game +.

Working on:
-Third person Mod. A beta TPS mod is coming soon.

Do you have any suggestions to improve the experience? 
Comment us here!

notes.title: Train Station #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.content:
Santa Lucia Train Station
Distance: 1 mile from Origin

- Do you hear that?
-Yes, it's the Train
-No ... it's something else

The Santa Lucia Train Station was founded by the Garcia Family when they took control of the town. Its travelers are said to take a train that comes from nowhere and goes nowhere.
Warden's Journal

notes.title: Timeline #RoadToTHEORIGIN
notes.content:
Since ancient times, many philosophers have interpreted evil as the opposite of good, an abstract and interpretive concept. However, in many writings of alchemists since the twelfth century they speak that evil is not abstract, they have even affirmed that it exists, that it is a localized entity with an epicenter and that it can alter the reality around it. Its provenance is unknown.

Timeline*
1864 - Beginning of the War of the Triple Alliance
1869 - THE ORIGIN
1932 - The Chaco War begins
1989 - Stroessner government falls
2013- Mayor of Asunción flees from justice

* Many events cited here are fictitious.
